cityOfTheWeek.intro: Lisbon is my reset city this week — hills, miradouros, and dinner that runs late without trying too hard.
tips: Ride Tram 28 early, before the midday crush.
Sunset from a miradouro beats any rooftop reservation scramble.
Order a pastel de nata where locals are actually queuing.
Walk Alfama downhill so your knees forgive you.
Leave one evening unplanned — the city fills the gap.
